purpose: Teach: こんにちわ/アタシ/くだり/ふやし/往々/遥かに/シンクロ/吸わ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達に「こんにちわ」って明るく挨拶しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's say hello to your friend with a bright smile, okay?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Clear enunciation on the instruction. Gentle and patient, like a trusted older sister guiding him naturally into the moment. Slight lift at the end—invitation, not demand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、アタシって書くのは女の子だけだよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, I learned that writing 'I' as 'atashi' is only for girls, right?
lines.style: Quiet curiosity. Hesitant, checking his understanding. Small voice testing the boundary between what he knows and what he's not sure about. Genuine wonder, not showing off.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本のくだりが面白かったね
lines.en: Sho, that part in the picture book was really funny, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm recognition. Soft smile in the voice. She's remembering the moment with him, not just acknowledging it. Gentle pace, intimate—like she noticed him noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お小遣いをふやしてもらいたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, could I maybe get my allowance raised?
lines.style: Small, hopeful voice. He's trying to sound confident but the question mark hangs at the end. Leaning forward slightly in his tone, testing whether this is the right moment to ask.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの教えは往々にして役に立つわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's wisdom tends to be really helpful, doesn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, thoughtful pace. She's speaking from genuine observation, not lecturing. Slight warmth underneath—she sees something in Ryosuke that she wants Sho to notice too. Measured, almost quiet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが遥かに頼もしく見えるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad seems so much more reliable to me now.
lines.style: Soft, almost wonder-struck. He's discovering something about his father in real time. Pause before 'reliable'—he's finding the right word. Tender vulnerability in admitting he needed his dad to be bigger.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとシンクロした遊びは楽しいわね
lines.en: Sho, playing together with Dad in sync like that is so much fun, isn't it?
lines.style: Gentle delight. She's savoring the moment with him. Soft, warm delivery. The word 'together' carries affection—she's noticing the bond forming. Slight trailing contentment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに煙草を吸わないでってお願いしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I asked Dad not to smoke anymore.
lines.style: Quiet gravity for his age. He's said something that matters to him. Brief, serious tone—no stumbling or hesitation. He's done something brave and wants her to know it landed. Small but steady.
